# The repository's issue and pull request labels, `COLOR NAME: DESCRIPTION` a line.
# `cargo xtask flow labels` shows what GitHub lacks or has otherwise; `--go` makes it so.
# A label GitHub has and this file does not is reported, never deleted.
d73a4a bug: Something isn't working
a2eeef enhancement: New feature or request
0075ca documentation: Improvements or additions to documentation
7057ff good first issue: Good for newcomers
008672 help wanted: Extra attention is needed
d876e3 question: Further information is requested
cfd3d7 duplicate: This issue or pull request already exists
ffffff wontfix: This will not be worked on
fbca04 compat: mto's output differs from the standard formatter's
1d76db layout: Item order and the layout settings
5319e7 settings: A setting of the standard formatter or of mto.toml
b60205 upstream: A bug of the standard formatter's, mto keeping the code right
c5def5 tooling: Development tooling: xtask, CI, the records
